Ena mwa iwo, akuyang'ana pamndandanda, anawona dzina la Pringle Drive, lomwe linali m'tawuni ya Cincinnati, Ohio. Pali nkhani ina - tchipisi tidatchedwa Mark Pringle, yemwe mu 1937 adafunsanso njira yatsopano yopangira mbatata. Mu Meyi 2009, Khothi Lalikulu ku London lidagamula tchipisi kukhala mbatata, kotero Procter & Gamble adayenera kulipira $ 100m ($ 156m) pamtengo wowonjezerapo mtengo pazaka zomwe tchipisi tidagulitsidwa ngati chotupitsa ku UK, komanso kulipira mtsogolo. £ 20 miliyoni pachaka.
Mu 1994, UK idakhazikitsa lamulo lokhazikitsa njira yokhometsa msonkho. Malinga ndi malamulowa, misonkho ilibe chakudya chambiri mdziko muno. Zopatulazo ndizopangidwa kuchokera ku mbatata, kuphatikiza batala yaku France, tchipisi ndi zinthu zofananira.

Fulvic acid kuonjezera ntchito za tizilombo microflora ndi kukhala mizu. Amasungunuka mosavuta m'nthaka ndipo amatha kupanga ndi mono- ndi divalent cations (mwachitsanzo, ndi K.+, Na+, NH4+, Ca2+, Mg2+) mchere wosasungunuka m'madzi, womwe umachepetsa mchere wa nthaka, ndipo zomera zimayamwa bwino chakudya. Komabe, pamalo okhala ndi zamchere kwambiri (pH> 10), mbali ya fulvic acid imatha kupangidwa ndi ma ayoni a calcium ndi barium. Ndi cations trivalent (Fe3+ ndi Al3+) ma fulvic acid amatha kutsika kapena kupanga zinthu zovuta kusungunuka m'madzi, koma sindinawonepo dothi kapena pH yamadzi ngati imeneyi. Madzi apamwamba kwambiri pH adawonedwa m'chigawo cha Rostov - 8,5.
Agriful Plus imaphatikizansopo betain. Amathandizira kuwongolera kuthamanga kwa osmotic ndikuwongolera kupezeka kwa michere. Kuphatikiza apo, ma betaines amathandizira kuti mizu izitha kuyamwa madzi, imakulitsa kukana kwa mbewu kumadera otentha kwambiri komanso otsika, komanso imathandizira kaphatikizidwe ka chlorophyll.
